venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.notes_summary: Happy 404 from Close Company Atlanta! Good start with 404 specials going over well. Some CO2 issues resolved. Many city events kept people away until late. Closers came at 8, lull until 10pm then picked up. Low on straws.

highlights.text: Above target — $6,498 vs $6,349 target (+2.3%)
Happy 404 Day! Specials went over very well with guests
86'd: Tito's, Grey Goose, Vida, Green Chartreuse

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.notes_summary: A slow Saturday. Weather, March Madness, and Easter hurt us. Still, solid night with lots of regulars and return guests carrying the slower nights. James's last day — team signed a Montenegro bottle for him.

highlights.text: Below target — $7,874 vs $11,706 target (-32.7%)
Weather, March Madness, and Easter hurt numbers
James's last day — team signed a Montenegro bottle for him

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.notes_summary: Smooth, busy night with great pacing. Slow morning start but steady lunch. Evening kicked off at 5pm with reservations and walk-ins. SMF shows drove pre-show rush. New high-top communal table was a huge hit. Room stayed full 5pm–kitchen close. Post-show pop at Hot Eye.

highlights.text: Above target — $18,781 vs $18,000 target (+4.3%)
379 guests — strong Saturday turnout
New communal high-top was a hit — guests connecting over drinks
Kelwin killed his first night training in THE

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.notes_summary: Interesting Saturday with 40-person wedding reception in Standing Room. Slow start but party was a blast. Electrical outage issues around 9pm took kitchen terminals down, but team rolled with it. Walk-ins picked up after 10:45pm once power restored. Room full until last call.

highlights.text: Crushed target — $13,494 vs $8,723 target (+54.7%)
Successful 40-person wedding reception in Standing Room
Electrical outage issues around 9pm — team handled it well
$4,440 event sales from wedding

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.notes_summary: Another smooth night, down a host again but same technique from Friday worked perfectly. Everyone on top of table turns, waitlist kept to minimum. Zero overly intoxicated baseball fans — guests had exactly the experience they came for.

highlights.text: Above target — $16,060 vs $15,082 target (+6.5%)
431 guests — strong Saturday with baseball Opening Weekend
Host technique from Friday worked perfectly again

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: Turn-heavy but relatively smooth night that fizzled after midnight. Line out the door to start. Rain plus day drinking kept crowds thinner. Never longer than 1.5hr waitlist. Lots of industry folks for last call including Dave from Attaboy.

highlights.text: Below target — $8,216 vs $9,254 target (-11.2%)
Rain and day drinking kept Saturday crowds thinner than usual
Top Sellers: Masari, Material Control, Wax Simulacra

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.notes_summary: Slow night. Folks possibly traveling or resting for Easter. Started with solid books but many no-shows, cancellations, and party size drops over the evening. 11 no-shows, 46 cancellations (17 day-of). Garden closed at 11:30 to consolidate. Team pushed food and upsold well with available tables.

highlights.text: Below target — $7,353 vs $10,301 target (-28.6%)
11 no-shows, 46 cancellations (17 day-of) — reservation challenges
Matt Belanger in town for a visit!
